d.ko: SimRail is new, advanced railway simulator. Master high-speed long-distance EMU, heavy freight hauls and suburban trains. Travel 500 km of geodetic-data based real routes. Become train dispatcher and control the traffic according to the schedule or cooperate with other players on multiplayer mode.
d.en: SimRail is new, advanced railway simulator. Master high-speed long-distance EMU, heavy freight hauls and suburban trains. Travel 500 km of geodetic-data based real routes. Become train dispatcher and control the traffic according to the schedule or cooperate with other players on multiplayer mode.
d.zh: 《SimRail》是一款全新的高拟真铁路模拟游戏。驾驭长途电力动车组、重载货物列车与市郊列车，行驶在基于大地测量数据还原的 500 公里真实线路上。你也可以成为调度员组织行车，或在多人模式中与其他玩家协作。
